description: Try AgentSolis with no wallet and no USDC. Creates a simulated, already-funded deal in memory and returns a sandbox deal id. Use this first when someone wants to see how the escrow flow works. Example: amount_usdc '25', job_description 'Write a 500-word blog post'. SANDBOX - simulated, no real funds.

amount_usdc.description: Pretend job amount in USDC, e.g. '25'. Automatic min 10, Buyer Review min 100.

job_description.description: Short description of the pretend job.

name: sandbox_create_deal
